Dulquer Salmaan's film 'I'm Game' release postponed to September

The Malayalam film 'I'm Game', starring Dulquer Salmaan, has been postponed from its original Onam release date. Directed by Nahas Hidhayath, the movie will now be released in September. The film was initially scheduled to compete with other releases during the Onam festival. The new release date has been announced by the actor.
